name: Jussi Kärkinen
bio:
Jussi's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally cars tearing through the Finnish countryside. After completing his technical training, he specialized in composite materials, quickly becoming adept at crafting and repairing lightweight components. Jussi honed his skills at smaller racing outfits before joining Rexal FMI Racing, where he's known for his meticulous attention to detail and proactive approach to problem-solving.

He excels at adapting to new technologies and enjoys working with a team to push the boundaries of performance. Jussi's ambition extends beyond simply executing tasks; he is eager to learn from senior engineers and contribute to innovative solutions that improve the team's competitive edge. His reliability and eagerness to mentor junior technicians make him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jussi is of average height with a stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when concentrating.
Refuses to drink coffee after 2 PM.
